ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels; high-intensity pixels are localized on the lateral lobes while low-intensity pixels dominate the medial and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer 50% of both lobes, featuring dense, low-intensity speckling (mottling). The medial region consists of a solid low-intensity dark mass extending from the notch to the peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 18% relative to fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 3-10 pixels across the entire trailing edge boundary; higher amplitude peaks are detected on the distal thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge, tapering into narrow, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters detected along the distal edges and tips, particularly on the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel-amplitude variations on the right distal tip (image-right) suggests potential minor tissue loss or dense colonization by sessile organisms.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the ventral-medial fluke surface by a foreground avian object (bird) in motion.
